title: Calibration, Evaluation, and Safety
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of lighting, driver variation, false alarms, and non-medical/non-safety certification, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in driver-drowsiness-detection.
learning_objectives: Explain lighting, driver variation, false alarms, and non-medical/non-safety certification in plain language and connect it to blinkDetect.py; WORKFLOW.md.
Trace one input through the calibration, evaluation, and safety stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
concepts_covered: lighting, driver variation, false alarms, and non-medical/non-safety certification
practical_outcomes: Trace the calibration, evaluation, and safety stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for lighting, driver variation, false alarms, and non-medical/non-safety certification.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
